value.rationale: The complete natural classification of repeated Bayesian opinion changes resolves whether a user of a real published model ever stops switching, identifies a strict open parameter set where the objectively worse initial opinion wins the majority of final realizations, and isolates a critical line where eventual stabilization is certain yet has infinite mean delay. These are motivated, behaviorally interpretable, exact continuous-parameter statements, not arbitrary finite instances or merely an implementation check.
